SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE (resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type IN ("k8s_node", "k8s_container", "k8s_pod")
      OR (resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_pod_status_phase/gauge` == 1))
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
    AND (`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` IS NULL OR `metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` == 1)
| EVAL cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.cluster),
       namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.namespace_name, resource.attributes.namespace),
       pod = COALESCE(resource.attributes.pod_name, attributes.pod)
| STATS cpu_util = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_utilization`),
        cpu_alloc = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_cores`),
        mem_util = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`),
        mem_alloc = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_bytes`),
        eph_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`),
        eph_total = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/total_bytes`),
        cpu_req = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/request_cores`),
        mem_req = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/request_bytes`),
        status = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp),
        phase = LAST(attributes.phase, @timestamp)
    BY cluster, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type,
       resource.attributes.node_name, attributes.condition, namespace, pod, resource.attributes.container_name
| EVAL pod_key = CONCAT(namespace, "/", pod)
| STATS cpu_used = SUM(cpu_util * cpu_alloc), cpu_alloc = SUM(cpu_alloc),
        mem_used = SUM(mem_util * mem_alloc), mem_alloc = SUM(mem_alloc),
        eph_used = SUM(eph_used), eph_total = SUM(eph_total),
        cpu_req = SUM(cpu_req), mem_req = SUM(mem_req),
        nodes = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready", resource.attributes.node_name, NULL)),
        nodes_ready = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready" AND status == "True", resource.attributes.node_name, NULL)),
        namespaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(namespace),
        pods_reporting = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_pod", pod_key, NULL)),
        problem_pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND phase IN ("Pending", "Failed", "Unknown"), pod_key, NULL)),
        ksm = COUNT(CASE(resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target", 1, NULL))
    BY Cluster = cluster, Location = resource.attributes.location, Project = resource.attributes.project_id
| EVAL `CPU %` = 100 * cpu_used / cpu_alloc,
       `Memory %` = 100 * mem_used / mem_alloc,
       Saturation = GREATEST(cpu_used / cpu_alloc, mem_used / mem_alloc),
       `Ephemeral storage %` = 100 * eph_used / eph_total,
       `CPU requested %` = 100 * cpu_req / cpu_alloc,
       `Memory requested %` = 100 * mem_req / mem_alloc,
       `Nodes ready` = nodes_ready, Nodes = nodes, Namespaces = namespaces, `Pods reporting usage` = pods_reporting,
       `Problem pods` = CASE(ksm > 0, problem_pods, NULL)
| KEEP Cluster, Location, Project, Saturation, `Nodes ready`, Nodes, Namespaces, `Pods reporting usage`, `Problem pods`, `CPU %`, `Memory %`, `Ephemeral storage %`, `CPU requested %`, `Memory requested %`
| SORT Saturation DESC
| LIMIT 100
